'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Stephen Munger DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Munger]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Why I'm #1, 769, 852, 615 In the world'''. No username. Handwritten. A brace groups L1–L2; starting card is the objective on L2 (not V). L1 Knowledge And Defense is (V). L4 Private Platform → Coruscant: Private Platform (Docking Bay). L18 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer. L19 Slave 1 → Boba Fett In Slave I (V). L20 and L36 sheet Cyborg Commander, Hunter of Jedi → Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi. L23 first word reads Batoc (dot over the second letter) → Battle Droid Squad (uncertain; L32 is clearly Battle Droid Squad). L28 and → Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba. L31/L54/L58 Galen, Secret Apprentice → Galen Marek, Secret Apprentice. L41 sheet IG Bodyguard Droid → IG-88 (uncertain; no card by the written name). L45 sheet Imperial Banner → The Empire's Back (uncertain). L48 sheet Elis Host → Elis Helrot (uncertain). L55 Masterful Move and Endor Occupation → Masterful Move & Endor Occupation.
